title: Machu Picchu
description: Discover the majesty of Machu Picchu, the world's most iconic Inca citadel. This full-day tour takes you from Cusco to the Andes summit, traveling by scenic train through the Sacred Valley to explore its temples, agricultural terraces, and the unique energy of this UNESCO World Heritage Site.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cusco
itinerary.description: Airport pickup and transfer to the hotel. Afternoon free to acclimate to the altitude and explore the city.

itinerary.title: Cusco City Tour
itinerary.description: Guided visit to the Plaza de Armas, the Cathedral, Qoricancha, and the impressive ruins of Sacsayhuamán.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley
itinerary.description: Tour through Pisac, Ollantaytambo, and Chinchero. Traditional lunch included and exploration of local markets.

itinerary.title: Machu Picchu
itinerary.description: Scenic train ride to Aguas Calientes, bus to the sanctuary, and full guided tour of the Inca citadel.

itinerary.title: Return to Cusco
itinerary.description: Return train to Ollantaytambo and transfer to the hotel in Cusco. End of service.
